This document covers the waste water treatment 
plant of AL-Arish power station.

The first draft was initiated by 
Chemist: Mohamed Mahmoud Kaheel; reviewed by department director Chemist Bekheet Abd El-haleem; 
revised by quality control chemist: Saad Sadeek Hassanen at EDEPC and accepted 
by eng. Mohamed El-said Abd El-ghfar; General Manager of Al-Arish Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.
The System includes the following Main Equipments:

items:
One (1) caustic feed tank 
and two (2x100%) dosing pumps.

One (1) coagulation 
preparation tank with one electric mixer and transfer pump.

One (1) coagulant feed 
tank with one electric mixer and two (2x100%) metering feed pumps.

One (1) flocculants 
(coagulant aid) dosing packing composed of one dosing hopper, two preparing 
tanks with two electric mixers one feeding tank and two (2x100%) metering feed 
pumps.

One flocculent preparing 
and feeding tank with one electric mixer and two metering feed pumps for 
dewatering in filter press.

Retention basin 
auxiliaries are composed of two (2x100%) waste water supply pumps, retention 
basin controls and other accessories

Oily water collecting 
basin auxiliaries composed of two oil skimmers, one oil removal system in a 
flotation basin by means of an air saturating process and two (2x100%) oil 
transfer pumps.

One flocculator with 
scraper bridge and (2x100%) sludge pumps for discharge to sludge thickener.

Two automatic pressure 
filters.

One 
sludge thickener and two (2x100%) sludge transfer pumps.

One sludge dewatering 
filter press.

One 
sludge cake transfer belt to disposal.

The main aim of waste water plant is the rejection of substances and particles 
 causing turbidity of water to be suitable to discharge it to the sea 
 satisfying the law of environments. Chemical substances were used for this 
 purpose by dosing them in the mentioned water as follow:

For removing suspend solids, ferric chloride solution ( 40% ) was used where 
 it is injected in the clarifier using ( 2x100% 
 ) dosing pumps and one dosing tank. When dosing occur ferric ions Fe+++ 
 will interact to the small particles scattered in water forming big particles 
 which will settle by gravity

For removing the most particles in water anionic polyelectrolyte substance was 
 used which injected in the clarifier by the aid of polyelectrolyte preparing 
 system which consisted of stainless steel tank dosing hopper, service water 
 source and (
 2x100% ) dosing pumps. The 
 poly electrolyte material will form aggregates of big particles previously 
 formed leading to settling down to the bottom of clarifier. The efficiency of 
 removing suspended solids is 90% to a minimum of 25 mg/l.

This design is present in the unit which contain soda tank and (
 2x100% 
 ) soda pump for injection in clarifier to adjust the PH water recommended for 
 coagulation process.

There are different tests carried out on the water produce from the clarifier 
 and from the final treatment of the unit to attain good quality water. These 
 test can be summarized as follow:

The PH value is measured in the field and in chemical lab using PH meters 
 designed for this purpose. The suitable PH value for coagulation process was 
 found to be ( 7-8 ) which attained using sodium hydroxide injection.

The turbidity of water is attributed to suspended solids of water so this 
 value is measured to keep the suitable turbidity of water using DR 2000 
 spectrophotometer, the range of turbidity designed for this unit is 25 NUT 
 after clarifier.

This test is carried out for determination the actual dose of chemicals for 
 obtaining good clarification, the test is occurred using flocculate instrument 
 which include mixers and beakers and dose different values of the chemical in 
 the beakers and start mixers, 20 minutes not good clarification and apply the 
 dose in the water as clarifier.

Clear water is separated from higher part of clarifier and go to the sand 
 filter to remove any residuals while the settled sludge are sucked from the 
 bottom of the clarifier and discharged to filter press to form cakes. For 
 knowing the quantity of sludge, a settling test is carried out to know the 
 percentage of sludge then sludge pump will operate a definite time to suction 
 the formed sludge:
 let as the flow rate of sludge pump is 2.2 m3 / h and the quantity 
 of sludge calculated is 1.8 m3 so the time of operation of sludge 
 pum = 1.8 / 2.2 = 0.8 hours = 49 minutes.

After collecting oily water in oily basin 2 oil skimmer are responsible for 
 the removal of oil on water surface.

After that the unremoved oil will be rejected during another stage which 
 consists of air flotation tank and saturation tank.

Residual oil in water can be removed by pushing air and water during 
 saturation tank then to air flotation tank which has oil scraper that remove 
 the floating oil.

Determination of oil is carried out in the chemical lab. using separating 
 system and chemical reagent for extraction of oil from water ( 1,1,1 
 trichloroethane ).

After being checked up thoroughly yet there has some possibility to show 
malfunctioning in some particular locality of the plant which is appared by the 
alarming system on the display of PLC. Then the following procedure should be followed up to determine the fault 
precisely and for the remedy of the fault.

Verify the exact value of PH on the display screen of PH meter which is the 
value of PH of flocculation mixing chamber. If the cycle is terminated consider that the lack of injection of caustic 
soda in the chamber. Verify the quantity of soda in the soda tank.

If the soda injection is regular then verify the PH reading with another 
portable instrument, if the reading of two meters differs considerably then 
washout PH probe by taking out from the flocculation chamber.

Before washing probe the water of chamber must be cleaned out. Replace the 
probe if necessary

startup:

items: Check up the availability of water,

Check up the electric tension of each electric equipment separately along 
 with control system,
The availability of chemical reagents,

The 
 availability of service air,

The correct functional status of each instrument 
 and

Check plant pressure in some particular portion where the pressure Is 
 principal issue

In case of unavailability of waste water keep in idle position all 
 electrical equipment to prevent against any dry running.

Electric tension of each electric equipment should be checked in order to 
 protect against any high or low voltage presence on the terminal point. Also 
 all electrical connections should be verified to avoid any wrong alignment or 
 any short cut of electric cable.

As the plant uses chemical reagents for treatment so it is better to fill 
 up each chemicals tank with respective chemicals in order to prevent against 
 any scarcity of chemicals during operation.

Service air should be available on the terminal point with proper pressure 
 status as to utilize for the pneumatic equipments.

Instruments of the plant should operate perfectly. 
 In case of disorderness 
 of any instrument repairing or replacing should be done.

If it is necessary to stop the plant for any reason then clean up each 
 equipment and tank after being brought up the plant in rest.
